system.text:
You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Colour Rows",
  "slug": "colour-rows",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "puzzle-board",
  "loop": "Tap a tile to slide it into the empty slot on a small board, rearranging colours until every row is a single solid colour. The puzzle ends when you solve it or no moves remain.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `puzzle-board`

# Puzzle board

The board only changes when the player acts. Nothing happens while the player thinks.

## Contract row

| field                | value        |
| -------------------- | ------------ |
| score                | `required`   |
| level                | `optional`   |
| end                  | `required`   |
| end reasons          | `win, stuck` |
| reset                | `soft`       |
| idle death gate      | `any-end`    |
| idle motion required | `no`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: `score` after each scoring move and `end` when the board is solved or has no legal move left. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- End with `win` when solved or `stuck` when no move remains. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## No clock

Never end the game on a timer. A player who waits forever must never see `end`. A still board between moves is correct.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let moves = 0;
function onCellTapped(cell) {
  if (!isLegal(cell)) return;
  apply(cell);
  moves += 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: points() });
  if (solved()) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: moves });
  else if (!anyLegalMove()) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "stuck" });
  draw();
}
```

Redraw on input and on resize; a continuous animation loop is optional.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build a puzzle board game where tapping tiles adjacent to an empty slot slides them, with the goal of making each row a solid colour, styled in paper-cut aesthetic.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Colour Rows</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---- Game setup ----
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";

let dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
let W = 0, H = 0;

function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  draw();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ---- Paper-cut palette ----
const PAL = {
  bg: "#f4ecd8",
  layer: "#e07a5f",
  accent: "#3d405b",
  highlight: "#81b29a",
};

// A few extra colours for tiles (cut-paper feel), derived tastefully
const TILE_COLORS = ["#e07a5f", "#81b29a", "#3d405b", "#f2cc8f"];

// seeded jitter so it doesn't flicker between draws
function seededRand(seed) {
  let s = seed % 2147483647;
  if (s <= 0) s += 2147483646;
  return function () {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return (s - 1) / 2147483646;
  };
}
const rand = seededRand(918273);
function jitter(px) {
  return (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * px;
}

// ---- Puzzle state ----
const ROWS = 3;
const COLS = 3;
const BOARD_SIZE = ROWS * COLS; // 9 cells, one empty
let board = []; // array of colour index, -1 = empty
let emptyIndex = 0;
let moves = 0;
let running = false;
let paused = false;
let gameOver = false;
let winFlag = false;
let stuckFlag = false;
let tapHintPulse = 0;

// Precompute jitter offsets per cell corner, stable per cell id
const cellJitters = {};
function getCellJitter(id) {
  if (!cellJitters[id]) {
    const localRand = seededRand(1000 + id * 37);
    cellJitters[id] = {
      tl: [(localRand() - 0.5) * 3, (localRand() - 0.5) * 3],
      tr: [(localRand() - 0.5) * 3, (localRand() - 0.5) * 3],
      br: [(localRand() - 0.5) * 3, (localRand() - 0.5) * 3],
      bl: [(localRand() - 0.5) * 3, (localRand() - 0.5) * 3],
    };
  }
  return cellJitters[id];
}

function makeSolvedBoard() {
  // Each row gets its own colour, filled fully, then remove one tile for empty slot
  const b = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      b.push(r); // colour index = row index (0..ROWS-1), matches TILE_COLORS
    }
  }
  return b;
}

function isRowSolved(r, b) {
  const start = r * COLS;
  let colour = -2;
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    const idx = start + c;
    if (b[idx] === -1) return false; // empty counts as not solved for that row unless we allow it
    if (colour === -2) colour = b[idx];
    else if (b[idx] !== colour) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function solved() {
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    if (!isRowSolved(r, board)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function neighborsOf(idx) {
  const r = Math.floor(idx / COLS);
  const c = idx % COLS;
  const list = [];
  if (r > 0) list.push(idx - COLS);
  if (r < ROWS - 1) list.push(idx + COLS);
  if (c > 0) list.push(idx - 1);
  if (c < COLS - 1) list.push(idx + 1);
  return list;
}

function anyLegalMove() {
  // legal move = any neighbor of empty can slide (always true unless solved is the only state and there's no move to make progress)
  // Since a slide is always possible if empty has any neighbor, "stuck" happens only if no move can ever change the board's solved status.
  // For this puzzle, a legal move exists whenever empty has neighbors AND board is not already solved.
  if (solved()) return false;
  return neighborsOf(emptyIndex).length > 0;
}

function shuffleBoard() {
  // Start solved then perform random legal slides to scramble, guaranteeing solvability
  board = makeSolvedBoard();
  emptyIndex = Math.floor(BOARD_SIZE / 2);
  board[emptyIndex] = -1;
  // Actually need emptyIndex chosen consistently; recompute properly:
  board = makeSolvedBoard();
  const startEmpty = BOARD_SIZE - 1;
  board[startEmpty] = -1;
  emptyIndex = startEmpty;

  const scrambleSteps = 60 + Math.floor(rand() * 30);
  let lastMove = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < scrambleSteps; i++) {
    const neigh = neighborsOf(emptyIndex).filter((n) => n !== lastMove);
    const pick = neigh.length > 0 ? neigh[Math.floor(rand() * neigh.length)] : neighborsOf(emptyIndex)[0];
    board[emptyIndex] = board[pick];
    board[pick] = -1;
    lastMove = emptyIndex;
    emptyIndex = pick;
  }
  // Avoid accidental already-solved shuffle
  if (solved()) {
    // do one more swap to break it, if possible
    const neigh = neighborsOf(emptyIndex);
    if (neigh.length > 0) {
      const pick = neigh[0];
      board[emptyIndex] = board[pick];
      board[pick] = -1;
      emptyIndex = pick;
    }
  }
}

function resetGameState() {
  moves = 0;
  gameOver = false;
  winFlag = false;
  stuckFlag = false;
  shuffleBoard();
}

function backToTitle() {
  running = false;
  paused = false;
  resetGameState();
  draw();
}

// ---- Drawing helpers (paper-cut style) ----
function roundRectPath(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawJitteredRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, r, cellId) {
  const j = getCellJitter(cellId);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r + j.tl[0], y + j.tl[1]);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r + j.tr[0], y + j.tr[1]);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w + j.tr[0], y + j.tr[1], x + w + j.tr[0], y + r + j.tr[1]);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w + j.br[0], y + h - r + j.br[1]);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w + j.br[0], y + h + j.br[1], x + w - r + j.br[0], y + h + j.br[1]);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r + j.bl[0], y + h + j.bl[1]);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + j.bl[0], y + h + j.bl[1], x + j.bl[0], y + h - r + j.bl[1]);
  ctx.lineTo(x + j.tl[0], y + r + j.tl[1]);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + j.tl[0], y + j.tl[1], x + r + j.tl[0], y + j.tl[1]);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function layout() {
  const margin = Math.min(W, H) * 0.08;
  const boardTop = H * 0.18;
  const boardSize = Math.min(W - margin * 2, H * 0.62);
  const cellSize = boardSize / COLS;
  const boardLeft = (W - boardSize) / 2;
  return { boardLeft, boardTop, boardSize, cellSize };
}

function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawTitlePlate() {
  const plateW = Math.min(W * 0.86, 520);
  const plateH = 90;
  const x = (W - plateW) / 2;
  const y = H * 0.05;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
  drawJitteredRoundedRect(x, y, plateW, plateH, 16, 9001);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
  ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(plateH * 0.4) + "px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("Colour Rows", W / 2, y + plateH / 2);
}

function drawBoard() {
  const { boardLeft, boardTop, boardSize, cellSize } = layout();

  // backing board plate (layer of card)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
  drawJitteredRoundedRect(boardLeft - 10, boardTop - 10, boardSize + 20, boardSize + 20, 20, 9002);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  for (let idx = 0; idx < BOARD_SIZE; idx++) {
    const r = Math.floor(idx / COLS);
    const c = idx % COLS;
    const x = boardLeft + c * cellSize;
    const y = boardTop + r * cellSize;
    const pad = cellSize * 0.06;
    const cx = x + pad;
    const cy = y + pad;
    const cw = cellSize - pad * 2;
    const ch = cellSize - pad * 2;

    const val = board[idx];
    if (val === -1) {
      // empty slot: draw a subtle inset
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.08)";
      drawJitteredRoundedRect(cx, cy, cw, ch, 10, idx + 500);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      continue;
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
    ctx.fillStyle = TILE_COLORS[val % TILE_COLORS.length];
    drawJitteredRoundedRect(cx, cy, cw, ch, 10, idx);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // highlight strip for depth
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18;
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    drawJitteredRoundedRect(cx + cw * 0.08, cy + ch * 0.08, cw * 0.5, ch * 0.25, 6, idx + 700);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // row solved indicators
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    if (isRowSolved(r, board)) {
      const y = boardTop + r * cellSize;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = PAL.highlight;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(boardLeft - 6, y + cellSize / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(boardLeft - 18, y + cellSize / 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }
}

function drawHud() {
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
  ctx.font = "bold 20px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.fillText("Moves: " + moves, 16, H - 40);
}

function drawEndOverlay() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.55)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const plateW = Math.min(W * 0.8, 460);
  const plateH = 160;
  const x = (W - plateW) / 2;
  const y = (H - plateH) / 2;

  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
  drawJitteredRoundedRect(x, y, plateW, plateH, 18, 9003);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;

  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px sans-serif";
  const msg = winFlag ? "Solved!" : "No moves left";
  ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, y + plateH * 0.4);

  ctx.font = "18px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Moves: " + moves + " — tap to play again", W / 2, y + plateH * 0.72);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawTitleScreen() {
  drawTitlePlate();

  // hint pulse
  tapHintPulse += 0.05;
  const alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tapHintPulse);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = PAL.accent;
  ctx.font = "bold 22px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("Tap to begin", W / 2, H * 0.85);
  ctx.restore();

  // small preview board (static, decorative)
  drawBoard();
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();

  if (!running) {
    drawTitleScreen();
    return;
  }

  drawTitlePlate();
  drawBoard();
  drawHud();

  if (gameOver) {
    drawEndOverlay();
  } else if (paused) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = PAL.bg;
    ctx.font = "bold 26px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Paused", W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

// ---- Interaction ----
function cellFromPoint(px, py) {
  const { boardLeft, boardTop, boardSize, cellSize } = layout();
  if (px < boardLeft || px > boardLeft + boardSize) return -1;
  if (py < boardTop || py > boardTop + boardSize) return -1;
  const c = Math.floor((px - boardLeft) / cellSize);
  const r = Math.floor((py - boardTop) / cellSize);
  if (c < 0 || c >= COLS || r < 0 || r >= ROWS) return -1;
  return r * COLS + c;
}

function isLegal(cell) {
  if (cell < 0 || cell >= BOARD_SIZE) return false;
  if (board[cell] === -1) return false;
  return neighborsOf(emptyIndex).includes(cell);
}

function apply(cell) {
  board[emptyIndex] = board[cell];
  board[cell] = -1;
  emptyIndex = cell;
}

function points() {
  // simple scoring: count solved rows
  let s = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) if (isRowSolved(r, board)) s++;
  return s;
}

function onCellTapped(cell) {
  if (!isLegal(cell)) return;
  apply(cell);
  moves += 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: points() });
  if (solved()) {
    winFlag = true;
    gameOver = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: moves });
  } else if (!anyLegalMove()) {
    stuckFlag = true;
    gameOver = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "stuck" });
  }
  draw();
}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;

  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    resetGameState();
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    draw();
    return;
  }

  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const px = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const py = event.clientY - rect.top;

  if (gameOver) {
    resetGameState();
    draw();
    return;
  }

  const cell = cellFromPoint(px, py);
  if (cell >= 0) onCellTapped(cell);
});

// ---- Boot ----
resetGameState();
resize();
CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Colour Rows", gameType: "puzzle-board", lang: "en" });
draw();

// light animation loop just for the title pulse (no timers with strings, RAF used)
function loop() {
  if (!running && !paused) {
    draw();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
